CH32X035 SSD1306 u8g2 renderer subset
=====================================

Project-local renderer files in ThirdParty/u8g2/csrc/:
  u8x8.h
  u8x8_compat.c
  u8g2_ch32x035_core.c
  u8g2_ch32x035_hvline.c

Upstream u8g2 files still required:
  u8g2.h
  u8g2_font.c

The generic 37 MB u8g2_fonts.c is NOT used by this firmware and is not kept in
the repository. No stock u8g2 font symbol is referenced anywhere in the code.

The active 6x12 font is supplied separately in:
  BSP/SSD1306/fonts.c
  symbol: font_menu_main_h12w6

Font source:
  TKWTL/Oscilloscope-STM32F103C8T6
  Application/MiaoUI/fonts/fonts.c

The project-local core implements only R0/full-buffer 128x64 rendering and the
basic primitives required by this firmware. SSD1306 transport remains the
asynchronous DMA path in BSP/SSD1306 + Peripheral/I2C.
